physicalNotes: Radius 0.998 +/- 0.033 solar radii from Ruggieri et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of XO-2 N b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...684A.116R/abstract): 694,309 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Temperature 5290 +/- 18 K from Ruggieri et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of XO-2 N b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...684A.116R/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
